hash_method: sha256 over sorted 'relpath:sha256(file)\n' lines for every regular file in the skill dir, plus 'relpath -> target\n' for every symlink

layout: skills/<group>/<skill>/ for every tracked entry; no flat entries. An optional untracked overlay mirrors the same shape under .local-meta/skills/<skill>/ and merges over the tracked tree at install time. See OVERLAY.md.
